build.reason: The recipe identifies the static library and target source, but the CMake defaults and generated configuration are not supplied, so a complete static build assessment is unavailable.

input.reason: For representable nonnegative lengths, the target passes its generated bytes to XML_Parse; the parser rejects malformed XML or invalid arguments through status, and the target has no assertion on parse success.

lifecycle.reason: Creation, child creation and frees are shown, but XML_ParserReset and setContext are needed to settle the odd-size and fixed-context paths.

control_flow.reason: The entry invokes ParseOneInput on four parsers. Each invocation makes one nonfinal and one final XML_Parse call, with error lookup and optional reset afterward; those calls reach the changed parse routes.

missing_information: expat/CMakeLists.txt: the XML_CONTEXT_BYTES default and any option that sets it.
expat/lib/xmlparse.c: complete XML_ParserReset and setContext bodies.
expat/lib/xmlparse.c: the processor behavior that determines whether a valid target input leaves a compactable partial token before its second XML_Parse call.

accepted.requirement: Exercise reparse deferral on a nonfinal call after a prior nonfinal call leaves a partial token, with the pending byte count still below the retry threshold and sufficient buffer space.
accepted.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates a parser; ParseOneInput makes one nonfinal XML_Parse with the entire fuzz input, then repeats the same bytes with isFinal=1.
accepted.failure_condition: On the first call m_partialTokenBytesBefore starts at zero, so the retry condition succeeds. On the second call finalBuffer is true, so the new skip decision is bypassed. No generated byte sequence can supply the required intermediate nonfinal call.
accepted.alternative_paths: The namespace and external-entity parsers repeat the same two-call pattern. The optional reset occurs after both calls, and this target never calls XML_ParseBuffer or XML_ResumeParser directly.
